profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
In this role, I interface with high-profile clients to development sophisticated software projects within budget and ahead of schedule. Specifically, I direct all aspects of website, application, and database framework design, automation testing, and support by integrating distinct tools and resources. I provide critical technical advisement with users, educating customers on software products and services while leading integration. 

My key projects include:
	Chick-fil-A.com: Spearheaded full process development and implementation of prime website features crafting unique software, automation scripts, and tools correlated to user stories. Oversaw complete testing creating fresh test scripts while maintaining automation suite delivering accurate results. Led troubleshooting and debugging strategies. Implemented Java, Cucumber, BDD Framework and Selenium tools.
	Chick-fil-A Canada: Created and maintained automation suite for the inaugural chick-fil-a.ca site based on user stories using BDD Framework, Cucumber, Java language and Selenium automation tool. 
	Clarabridge: Implemented strategies to develop Cox Communications’ social media app functions, storage, and uses of all data. Innovated the data load ingests transferred to big data environment by creating python scripts, data filters, data validation conditions. Oversaw automation testing tool creation and utilization for all required testing features. Utilized technical skills with Big Data, Hive, Oozie, and Python tools. 
	Linehaul: Helmed the project development and testing activities of the SAIA application managing truck and freight information improving efficiency and profitability. Delivered UI development, modules, and front-end components for specific client needs. Led all testing, troubleshooting, debugging, API creation, services, and data connections of the application. Integrated Angular 5, HTML, and CSS tools.

positions.title: Box Office employee
positions.description: In this position, as a member of the box office employee, I was responsible for providing excellent guest service. Balancing and reconciling daily/nightly ticket sales.

company.name: The University of Texas at Arlington

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
In this position, I provided android application expertise delivering software development projects incorporated for clients to manage online features and processes. I also collaborated with team members reviewing and analyzing system specifications while innovating strategies for instrumental test planning, execution, and analysis.

My key project included:

	Tournament Management System: I designed and developed a gaming tournament android app engineering product code, documentation logs, and testing. I then reported all testing phases, defects, bugs and errors to development teams. I successfully deployed the beta version of the application for the company.

projects.title: Amazon Web Services – EC2 & S3
projects.description:
Technology used: Python | Flask | Amazon EC2 | Amazon S3 | MySQL | Bootstrap

Implemented EC2 as the Webserver that host the python flask application that can store, list and delete images stored in S3 and RDS. IAM is used to authorize user. Encrypted the file while uploading at cloud and decrypted once user download it.

projects.title: Big Data Analytics and Visualization
projects.description:
Technology used: Python|D3.js|Amazon EC2|Hadoop|Map‐Reduce|Bootstrap|MongoDB

Developed a web service that provides visual & graphical analytics of Earthquakes data, useful for knowing the frequency of the earthquakes by location, week‐by‐week, Day‐by‐day. Graph representation in D3.js, helps understand relationship between magnitude and depth, Location, and magnitude in an easy way.
